SAY IT YOUR WAY

Voice & phrases

Reply voice

Voice previews don’t change your saved selection. These voices run locally on the server.

Settings apply when the assistant finishes its current request. Additional model imports can be added later.

Wake & listening

Wake detection runs on the server. The rear mute button stops microphone capture.

—

Changing the wake word needs a vocabulary and detection check. Action phrases and responses are in Buttons & actions.

Listen test

Stopped

Speak normally, with or without «махи». This mode writes what it hears here and does not execute actions. Text is kept in memory only.

Input level —

Raise sensitivity for quiet speech; lower it if the meter clips. Lower the threshold to detect softer speech, or raise it to ignore room noise. Use Save voice settings to apply changes. An abandoned test expires automatically.

Recent voice requests

Wake detections, recognized words, matched commands, and results. Includes captured request audio for playback. Clips beyond the chosen limit are deleted locally. History stays local and survives voice-service restarts.

Saved recognition tests

Speak calmly at your usual distance. Compare input level and clipping with both transcripts before changing sensitivity or thresholds. Only these explicit tests save audio on the server.









YOUR SHORTCUTS
Buttons & actions




Action catalog
Used whenever an action response is left empty. Leave the default empty for silence.
Each action has voice phrases and response variants, one per line. A blank response uses the default response above. Placeholders: {duration}, {temperature}, {city}, {degrees}, {time}, {action}, and mapped {result_NAME}. Timer duration is requested with its voice phrase. Timer and pairing windows keep their own duration.


Button bindings
Conditional priority rules
Rules run top to bottom for each button and gesture. A rule only runs when its condition matches; a consumed match stops lower rules and the regular binding. Center tap checks the active assistant, then timer or picker, then active local actions, then falls back to playback.
Rear mute always changes microphone privacy.


Speaker configuration
Presets and animation frames used by the action catalog.
Advanced speaker configuration


Server configuration
Connect Home Assistant APIs here, then assign a voice phrase.
Create / edit HTTP action
Objects use JSON. Argument types: text, number, duration, enum. Use {argument} in URL and body values. Result mappings use dotted JSON paths.
Edit server action YAML
Reference environment variables for secrets. YAML changes apply to the next action.
